name: Acetoxymethylketobemidone
summary: Acetoxymethylketobemidone (O-AMKD), is an opioid designer drug related to ketobemidone, with around the same potency as morphine. It was first identified in Germany in October 2020.

uses.text: Acetoxymethylketobemidone (O-AMKD), is an opioid designer drug related to ketobemidone, with around the same potency as morphine.

pharmacology.en: It acts on the μ-opioid receptor, the main target of opioid painkillers, which relieves pain but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它作用於μ鴉片受體，也就是鴉片類止痛藥的主要作用目標；它能止痛，也會使呼吸變慢。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它作用于μ鸦片受体，也就是鸦片类止痛药的主要作用目标；它能止痛，也会使呼吸变慢。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the fentanyl analogues, cause drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils. They can slow or stop breathing, and overdose is often fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的吩坦尼類似物會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小。它們可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，過量常常致命。長期使用會導致成癮與戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的吩坦尼类似物会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小。它们可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，过量常常致命。长期使用会导致成瘾与戒断反应。

fact.en: It was first identified in Germany in October 2020, one of a wave of new opioids based on ketobemidone, an older painkiller still used in parts of Scandinavia.
fact.zh: 它於2020年10月在德國首次被確認，屬於一波以ketobemidone為基礎的新型鴉片類藥物；ketobemidone是一種較舊的止痛藥，在北歐部分地區仍在使用。
fact.zhHans: 它于2020年10月在德国首次被确认，属于一波以ketobemidone为基础的新型鸦片类药物；ketobemidone是一种较旧的止痛药，在北欧部分地区仍在使用。
